name: mcp-track-tokens

mcpTrackTokens.serverUrl.description: Base URL of the MCP Track Tokens server.

mcpTrackTokens.autoStartSession.description: Automatically start a tracking session when a supported prompt is submitted.

mcpTrackTokens.inactivityThresholdMinute.description: Minutes of inactivity before a session is paused.

mcpTrackTokens.enableHeartbeat.description: Send session heartbeats while tracking is active.

mcpTrackTokens.enablePromptHashing.description: Send a salted SHA-256 hash of prompt content (never the content itself by default).

mcpTrackTokens.storePromptContent.description: Send prompt content to the server. Disabled by default for privacy.

mcpTrackTokens.showStatusBar.description: Show the tracking status bar item.

mcpTrackTokens.defaultProject.description: Optional default project ID (GUID) when registration is not needed.

chatParticipants.name: track
chatParticipants.description: Ask @track to run a language-model request while recording prompt activity (length/hash only by default).
